`final class UIMouseEvent<U extends UI>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIInputEvent<U>`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIMouseEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UIMouseEvent.java)

The event of a press, a release or a drag on a UI, with the position of the pointer and the button.

## Description

[`UI.handleMousePressed`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-handleMousePressed), [`UI.handleMouseReleased`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-handleMouseReleased) and [`UI.handleMouseDragged`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-handleMouseDragged) receive it, for example to close a menu on a press in an empty area.

## Learn more

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#follow-an-input-through-the-tree)

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `double` | [getMouseX](#UIMouseEvent-method-getMouseX)() | Returns the horizontal position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI. |
| `double` | [getMouseY](#UIMouseEvent-method-getMouseY)() | Returns the vertical position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI. |
| `long` | [getDeltaTime](#UIMouseEvent-method-getDeltaTime)() | Returns, for a drag or a release, the time in ms since the button went down (`0` for a release whose press JOID did not see); `0` for a press. |
| [`MouseButton`](/reference/input/mousebutton/) | [getButton](#UIMouseEvent-method-getButton)() | Returns the [`MouseButton`](/reference/input/mousebutton/) of the event; for a drag, the button held. |

## Method details

<a id="UIMouseEvent-method-getMouseX"></a>

### getMouseX

`double getMouseX()` 

Returns the horizontal position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI.

<a id="UIMouseEvent-method-getMouseY"></a>

### getMouseY

`double getMouseY()` 

Returns the vertical position of the pointer, in design pixels of the UI.

<a id="UIMouseEvent-method-getDeltaTime"></a>

### getDeltaTime

`long getDeltaTime()` 

Returns, for a drag or a release, the time in ms since the button went down (`0` for a release whose press JOID did not see); `0` for a press.

<a id="UIMouseEvent-method-getButton"></a>

### getButton

`MouseButton getButton()` 

Returns the [`MouseButton`](/reference/input/mousebutton/) of the event; for a drag, the button held.
